title: Turkish-Style Masarepa Flatbread
description: A traditional Turkish flatbread made with masarepa, roasted to perfection in the oven. Perfect as a side dish or snack.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the masarepa, water, olive oil, salt, and yeast. Mix well to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough on a floured surface and shape it into a ball.
Roll out the dough into a thin circle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Transfer the dough to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the flatbread in the oven for 10-12 minutes, or until it's golden brown and crispy.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the flatbread warm, garnished with your choice of toppings.
